丁度良い。

ユ・ファスの裔よ……
ぬしは、ハル・ハリ族にとって貴き存在だ。
text.official_en:
Descendant of Yu Phas. Your life is sacred to the
Har Hali.
text.real_en:
Descendant of Yu Phas. Your life is sacred to the
Har-Hari.

感謝してもし切れぬ。
text.official_en:
Queen of Saramis, I cannot thank you enough for
accepting us.

text.jp:
族長代理の役目を終え、ハル・ハリの戦士として
戦いの場を欲していたところだった……
text.official_en:
Now that I have finished my service as acting chief,
I was seeking a place to fight as a Har Hali warrior.

text.jp:
故に……力を貸してやりたい。
共に戦わせてはくれぬだろうか。
text.official_en:
My strength is yours, if you will have it. Would you
allow me to fight at your side?

われが力をつけるためにもな。
text.official_en:
I would be a boon to you, and I in turn would be
strengthened through combat.

evidence.note: authored person identifier for this physical message slot; Person.bin contains PID_ヌッツォ

戦果は約束しよう……
text.official_en:
As a Har Hali warrior, I promise that my victories
will be yours as well.

戦いの折には呼ぶがいい。

敵の首を取ってみせようぞ……

I will hasten to join you wherever you are, that I
might take the heads of your enemies.

from me to gainsay your decision.

mind, I would eagerly accept.

It is a fast way to die in your sleep.
